content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional payment platforms often charge high transaction fees, such as Gumroad’s 10%, which can significantly cut into your profits. In contrast, NOWPayments only charges 0.5%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings. This difference becomes substantial over time; for instance, with 100 sales a month at $97 each, you would save $921 annually by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad. The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to ensure that you retain full ownership and control over your assets, making it a superior choice for creators facing restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can launch your digital product store, ensure you have the necessary components in place. You’ll need a domain name for branding, a reliable hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and a backend solution such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for transaction processing. Additionally, familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, which will allow you to accept various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Consider acquiring the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the blueprints and templates you'll need for a seamless setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To effectively sell your digital products, you'll need to set up a streamlined payment and delivery pipeline. Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept the desired cryptocurrencies, ensuring you understand the conversion rates. Next, integrate your backend solution (Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers) to handle payment verification and product delivery. Use storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to ensure your customers can access their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
NOWPayments allows you to keep 99.5% of your earnings.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your payment and delivery system thoroughly before promoting your store. Conduct a trial transaction to ensure that payments process seamlessly through NOWPayments, and that customers receive their digital products promptly. Update your website to reflect your unique brand, highlighting your offerings. Once satisfied with the testing phase, promote your store through social media and other channels to attract potential customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your digital product store, focus on scaling your operations. Monitor sales data to identify trends and adjust your offerings based on customer preferences. Consider expanding your product range by adding more ebooks, courses, or digital templates. Utilize performance analytics to optimize your marketing strategies and drive more traffic to your store. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is an invaluable asset for scaling, giving you access to additional templates and resources for ongoing development.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging a sovereign commerce stack. This involves using platforms like NOWPayments for crypto transactions and tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for delivery. This infrastructure empowers you to retain full ownership of your products while minimizing transaction fees significantly compared to traditional platforms.
No platform can restrict your access to your own products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It includes all the blueprints and templates necessary to build your own sovereign digital store, tailored for creators seeking independence from conventional payment platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

Register a domain name that represents your brand. Choose a hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Set up a NOWPayments account for cryptocurrency processing. Select a backend solution, such as Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders. Decide on a file delivery method using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Conduct thorough testing of the payment and delivery systems. Launch your store and promote it through social media and other channels.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I accept cryptocurrency payments?

To accept cryptocurrency payments, set up a NOWPayments account. Configure it to accept various cryptocurrencies and link it to your store. Ensure your backend solution processes payments efficiently.
What platforms can I use to host my digital store?
You can host your digital store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Both options provide free hosting and are suitable for serving your products without restrictions.
How do I manage order deliveries?
Use Google Sheets or Supabase to manage your orders. Combine this with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, ensuring customers receive their products instantly after payment.
What if I need more templates for my store?
If you need more templates, consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It includes access to all templates and blueprints necessary to enhance your digital store.
How do I scale my digital product offerings?
To scale your offerings, monitor sales data to identify trends, expand your product range, and optimize marketing strategies based on performance analytics.
Your digital store remains operational without recurring fees.
